stem: 以下哪一项是私营企业在共享数据和情报以打击金融犯罪时的关键考虑因素？

options.A: 高级管理人员对于哪些团队应参与数据共享计划的偏好
options.B: 数据共享系统的成本以及其是否在现有的信息技术预算之内
options.C: 数据共享带来的潜在投资回报率（ROI）与预防金融犯罪所付出的努力之间的关系
options.D: 确保共享数据符合适用的数据保护法规，同时保持信息的完整性和准确性

stem_en: Which of the following is a critical consideration for private sector firms when sharing data and intelligence to combat financial crime?

options_en.A: The preference of upper management regarding which teams should participate in the data-sharing initiative
options_en.B: The cost of the data-sharing system and whether it fits within the existing IT budget
options_en.C: The potential return on investment (ROI) from the data shared versus the financial crime prevention effort
options_en.D: Ensuring that the shared data complies with applicable data protection regulations while maintaining the integrity and accuracy of the information
